groups.title: 1. First keyframe
groups.note: The still the video starts from. Sets light, framing and position. Check it hardest.

groups.title: 2. Cast
groups.note: One sheet per person: clean face + headless outfit front/back. Detail close-ups sit beside the master.

assets.name: Cyan – character sheet (master)

assets.name: Trading floor – night (master)
assets.role: Location reference: rows of multi-monitor desks, central walkway, city lights at the far end

assets.name: Boardroom – night (master)
assets.role: Location reference: long walnut table, chart on wall screen, cyan cove lighting, city at night

assets.name: Home office – day (master)

assets.name: Home office – night (master)
